simple.meaning: פָּרָא (pârâʼ) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to bear fruit.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Hosea, beginning at Hosea 13:15. The surrounding contexts include family.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to פָּרָא (H6500) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: פָּרָא (pârâʼ) / H6500 is traced through Hosea 13:15 with source-language evidence and verse context.
